slides.title: THE PROBLEM
bullets: Personal financial planning requires balancing 5 competing priorities:
Savings · Investments · Debt Repayment · Emergency Fund · Goals
Optimising one area hurts another — no way to know the best split
Life changes (income drop, new expense) break any static plan

bullets.text: Most people guess. We solve with mathematical optimisation.

slides.notes: Light off-white background (#F4F5F9) matching website. Purple title. Explain the 5 competing priorities.

slides.title: OUR SOLUTION
bullets: Web app that takes your financial profile and outputs optimal allocation
LP/QP solver maximises a well-being score, not just wealth
Dynamic re-planning: re-runs optimiser when life changes
AI-powered recommendations via Groq (Llama 3.3 70B)
6-page interactive dashboard with charts and projections
slides.notes: Overview of solution. Highlight live deployment URL in purple.

slides.title: ALGORITHM: OBJECTIVE FUNCTION

bullets.text: Maximise Financial Well-Being Score (not just wealth):
Penalty — Underfunded goals, low emergency reserves

bullets: Fallback: Rule-based waterfall method if solver fails
slides.notes: Use website color tokens for each weight: amber for emergency, teal for debt, purple for investments, green for goals, red for penalties.

slides.title: ALGORITHM: CONSTRAINTS
bullets: Budget: sum(allocations) ≤ disposable income
Minimum debt payments: every debt gets at least its minimum
Non-negativity: no category can receive negative allocation
Emergency fund cap: stops adding once target reached
Goal feasibility: flags impossible deadlines

bullets.text: These constraints mirror real financial rules

slides.notes: Constraints that make the optimisation realistic. Purple highlight on key takeaway.

slides.title: DYNAMIC RE-PLANNING
bullets: When life changes, the system doesn't just tweak the old plan

bullets.text: It re-runs the ENTIRE optimiser from scratch with updated parameters

bullets: The new plan is globally optimal for the new conditions
Supported events:
Income change · New expense · Rate change · New goal · Emergency expense

bullets.text: Original vs Revised plan shown side by side with divergence chart

slides.notes: Key differentiator. Purple highlight on the comparison feature.
